fact: Gabonreview reports that on 28 April 2026 the DGI, CNSS and CNAMGS launched work on the Declaration unique des salaires, in which the NIF for employers and the NIP for employees becomes compulsory, with operation targeted for July 2026.

World Bank-funded workshops opened on 23 June 2025 to plan implementation of the Systeme national d'identite digitale (SNID) under the Gabon Digital programme, with a roadmap to be drawn before projects start.
The Gabon Digital programme, World Bank financed and run by the digital economy ministry, includes a national digital identity system meant to modernise identification and access to public services.
GabonReview says the SNID will give every resident a digital identity with the same legal value as physical identity, with signatures, payments and validations authenticated.
